An Android launcher for DeepSeek Harness: it runs the Node.js CLI and its Web UI inside a Linux container (proot / proroot), so the whole harness works on a phone.
DeepSeek Harness — the CLI and Web UI this launcher runs
DSHA — container bootstrap, wireless ADB pairing, PTY terminal (MIT, qiannianhuanxiang)
DSHM — online runtime delivery and mirror racing (GPL-3.0)
FolkPatch — the Compose UI and theme system this app is built on (GPL-3.0, LyraVoid / matsuzaka-yuki)
Termux terminal-view / terminal-emulator — the PTY and terminal emulation (Apache-2.0)

Without real hardlink support, pnpm\'s links point into its content store, so a plugin\'s client bundle cannot be found and the service fails to start. Rebuilding wipes node_modules and reinstalls with real file copies (keeps pnpm-lock.yaml; may take a few minutes, and the service cannot start while it runs). If you set packageImportMethod yourself in the profile\'s pnpm-workspace.yaml, that setting is kept and this may not help.
Plugin tree failed to load. Try Settings → Function → Rebuild plugin dependencies, or remove the plugin that was just installed.
After installing a plugin, start dsh once on a temporary port to check the plugin tree loads; on failure the plugin is uninstalled automatically. Adds 30s–3min per install.

When config is broken / DSH will not start

Everything above goes through the dsh-config-manager plugin, which lives inside DSH — if DSH will not start, neither will it. The same project also ships a standalone CLI that does not depend on the DSH runtime at all, so it is the first thing to reach for when configuration is broken or you are restoring onto a new machine. Installing or updating the plugin does not give you the CLI command: it must be installed separately with the first command below.

The window applies to logcat, the kernel log and crash dumps. Device state snapshots (properties, mounts, kernel config) have no time dimension and are always collected in full, so right after a reboot — or when a crash happened inside the window — the archive may not shrink much.
